primary_naics.label: Financial Transactions Processing, Reserve, and Clearinghouse Activities

description: ITGC-Infotech Global Consultancy Private Limited, known as European Pay, is a French fintech company that develops and operates a digital payment platform utilizing QR technology for contactless transactions. The company provides digital payment solutions, including mobile recharges, bill payments, and online shopping, as well as a digital wallet service. European Pay serves small and medium-sized enterprises, street vendors, and local vendors, and collaborates with banks to deliver financial services. The company is a member of the DPS TradeMark and DPS SAS and incorporates eco-friendly practices by eliminating paper receipts.

KAPSOON, SAS, DBA Kapsoon, is a French company specialized in digital human resources software solutions for insurance agents and brokers. The company provides a SaaS-based HR management platform that integrates with CRM systems to support HR processes, performance management, onboarding, offboarding, document management, employee training, performance evaluation, and payroll automation. Kapsoon serves agencies and users across France.

Asys is a French software publisher specialized in human resources (HR) management software. The company provides a suite of HR management solutions, including time management, planning, talent management, and recruitment, designed to support clients in sectors such as healthcare, industry, retail, agriculture, and leisure. Asys also offers training and support services related to its software, and emphasizes regulatory compliance and performance in its offerings.

quarksUp is a French software company that develops and provides human resources management software as a service. The company offers a platform for centralized and automated HR processes, including recruitment, employee onboarding, mobility, training, payroll management, and e-learning. quarksUp serves organizations of various sizes and sectors, such as private companies, public organizations, and educational institutions, and is part of the Visma Group.
core_offerings: Training and E-Learning Management Software Development

description: NOVRH is a French company specialized in the development and integration of SIRH (Système d'Information des Ressources Humaines) and payroll software solutions for medium-sized enterprises in France. The company provides a modular, web-based HR and payroll management platform, including modules for payroll, personnel administration, absence management, benefits and remuneration, talent management, recruitment, training, and HR decision-making tools. NOVRH serves private and public companies across sectors such as healthcare, social services, and medical-social fields, and operates a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) model with secure data hosting in France. The company also offers hosting, implementation, training, maintenance, and hotline support.
core_offerings: HR and Payroll Software Training Services

description: Virtualia is a French software company specialized in human resources management solutions for the public sector. The company provides a comprehensive HR management system that includes personnel administration, payroll processing, workforce management, salary management, employment management, professional training, career management, and time management. Virtualia also offers training services related to its HR software.

Kéméo, DBA Kammi, is a French company specialized in human resources management software and consulting services. The company develops and provides a modular suite of HR management solutions, including administrative HR management, talent management, and payroll management, serving SMEs and medium-sized enterprises in over 10 countries. Kammi also offers externalization services such as payroll preparation and talent management.

Cantoriel SIRH, DBA Cantoriel, is a French software company that develops and provides integrated and modular Human Resources Information System (SIRH) software, including payroll, general tax administration, and human resources management. The company offers solutions for payroll management, personnel administration, time and activity management, talent management, professional training, recruitment, and HR operations. Cantoriel also provides digitalization services, software maintenance, and supports both on-premise and cloud hosting. Its platform is designed to support multi-statut employees, various contracts and collective agreements, and job assignments for public and private sector organizations. The company serves a range of industries, including electrical and gas, sanitary and medical-social, EPIC-GIP, and entertainment and leisure sectors.
core_offerings: Time and Activity Management Software Development
Payroll and HR Software Integration Services

description: Sun RH is a French software company engaged in providing human resources (HR) management solutions for businesses of all sizes and sectors, including industrial, commercial, healthcare, and educational organizations. The company offers a comprehensive HR software platform that integrates recruitment management, payroll processing, leave and absence tracking, training management, and talent management, as well as electronic contract signing, automated data processing, and real-time HR reporting. Sun RH serves both SMEs and large enterprises, with features tailored for large organizations and integration with other internal systems. The company also provides ongoing support and training to its clients.
core_offerings: HR Software Customization and Integration Services
Real-Time HR Reporting and Analytics Solutions
Leave and Absence Tracking Software Solutions

description: Staff & Go is a French company engaged in agile human resources software solutions, focusing on payroll and personnel management. The company provides a modular HR platform that integrates with payroll software, offering modules for recruitment, leave and absence management, time management, payroll variables, professional interviews, internal communication, expense notes, and electronic signature. Staff & Go serves a diverse clientele, including accounting firms, companies, and integrators, and operates globally, with a particular focus on businesses in the HR and payroll sectors.
core_offerings: Leave and Absence Management Software Development

description: INPACT is a French company specialized in payroll and human resources software solutions, operating as a publisher and integrator of HR and payroll management systems. The company provides software for payroll and HR management, including automation of payroll processes, integration with existing HR and payroll systems, and features such as HR indicators, cost tracking, and electronic contract management. INPACT also offers consulting, advisory services, shared outsourcing, and specialized development in areas including payroll, social management, human resources, accounting, taxation, and auditing. The company serves small and medium-sized enterprises and large organizations across France.
core_offerings: Payroll and HR Software Consulting Services
Payroll and HR System Automation Solutions
Payroll and HR Software Training Services
Payroll and HR Software Post-Integration Support Services
Payroll and HR Software Customization Services
Payroll and HR Software Pre-Project Audit Services
Payroll and HR Software Shared Outsourcing
Payroll and HR Software Support Services

description: Jooma is a French company specialized in digital HR and payroll management services, offering SaaS solutions for startups, small and medium enterprises, and organizations with less than 100 employees. The company provides payroll automation, HR management, expense notes, talent management, onboarding/offboarding, professional meetings, and digital HR security services, including digital vaults and electronic HR signatures. Jooma also offers training through its Jooma Academy and is a partner of Silae, a SaaS payroll and HR management software provider.
core_offerings: Digital HR and Payroll Management Solutions
Digital Vault and Electronic Signature Services

description: Collective Knowledge is a French company operating in the information technology and services sector, with a focus on artificial intelligence, machine learning, and automation. The company develops open-source platforms and workflow automation frameworks for co-designing software and hardware to support AI and ML workloads, and provides IT services and consulting related to these domains. Collective Knowledge also organizes public hackathons and collaborates with industry partners to advance research and development in AI and ML.

Decathlon SE, DBA Decathlon, is a French company specialized in the retail of sporting goods, including clothing, sports equipment, and sportswear. The company operates a global network of stores and manages the research, design, production, logistics, and distribution of its products in-house. Decathlon also develops its own brands and collaborates with pro athletes and industry partners in its design centers and R&D labs. The company is committed to sustainability and has implemented initiatives to reduce its environmental footprint.

primary_naics.label: Cut and Sew Apparel Manufacturing (except Contractors)

description: Christian Dior SE is a French multinational luxury goods company engaged in the design, production, and distribution of fashion and beauty products. The company operates in the luxury goods industry, offering a range of products including handbags, ready-to-wear, jewelry, watches, haute couture, fragrances, makeup, skincare, and home goods. Dior also manages a global network of boutiques and spas, including Dior Spa, which provides luxury wellness retreats and services. The company serves both individual consumers and businesses in multiple regions, including Europe, North America, South America, the Middle East, and Asia Pacific. Dior is publicly traded on Euronext Paris and is part of the CAC All-Share index.
core_offerings: Makeup and Skincare Product Development and Production
Perfume and Fragrance Development and Production
Luxury Fashion Product Design and Manufacturing

description: Produit en Bretagne is a French collective network that represents and supports companies across Brittany, spanning sectors such as agro-food, distribution, industry, culture, tourism, and services. The organization provides services including job placement, training, and social responsibility initiatives, and operates an online boutique offering textile and daily-use products made in France with at least one production step in Brittany. Produit en Bretagne also organizes events such as culinary competitions and cultural festivals, and collaborates with member companies to promote local production and employment.

Atos SE is a French multinational company that provides information technology services, digital transformation solutions, and consulting. The company delivers services in cloud and infrastructure, cybersecurity, data and artificial intelligence, application services, smart platforms, and digital workplace solutions. Atos also offers consulting and advisory services, as well as managed services and integration services. The company operates internationally, serving businesses, institutions, and communities in over 61 countries. Atos is part of the GAIA-X initiative and is involved in sustainability initiatives, including decarbonization and digital transformation.

Mon BE Fluides is a French engineering company engaged in the design and execution of fluid systems for tertiary buildings, including schools, clinics, hotels, hospitals, and other similar facilities. The company provides integrated engineering services covering heating, ventilation, and air conditioning, plumbing, electrical, and fire safety systems. Mon BE Fluides also offers Building Information Modeling (BIM) and 3D modeling solutions, and collaborates with industry partners on complex projects such as industrial energy storage sites. Its services are available to a diverse range of clients, including educational institutions, healthcare providers, hospitality businesses, care facilities, companies, offices, and sports complexes.
core_offerings: Technical Coordination and Conflict Resolution Services

description: Agir&Tude is a French engineering consulting firm that provides technical engineering and product development services, including 3D modeling, technical validation, engineering consulting, new product design, analytical and numerical calculations, and technical audits. The company also offers process analysis and improvement, as well as support for sustainable design and eco-conception. Agir&Tude serves clients in sectors such as lifting, railway, research and development, aerospace tooling, building products, and hydraulic oil, and employs certified professionals in areas including surfacing, mold tools, sustainable design, welding, and sheet metal work.
core_offerings: Development Process Analysis and Optimization Services
Advanced Surfacing and Mold Tooling Services

description: EcoViso SAS, DBA Ecoviso, is a French consulting company specialized in eco-responsible solutions, with a focus on water management, sustainable development, and ecological transitions. The company provides consulting, regulatory compliance, strategic support, commercial assistance, project management, and project implementation services to industrial, agricultural, and technological startups, with a particular emphasis on the Mediterranean region. Ecoviso also offers resources and tools to support clients in navigating regulatory environments and implementing sustainable solutions.
core_offerings: Natural and Usage Cycle Analysis Services
Water Pricing and Financial Advisory Services
Innovation and Mergers and Acquisitions Advisory

description: La Péro is a French company engaged in the production and export of alcoholic beverages, with a focus on wine-based drinks. The company operates as a food manufacturer and food and beverage exporter, offering a sparkling, fruit-flavored alcoholic beverage made from French Chardonnay wine, which is gluten-free and free from bitterness. La Péro serves bars and consumers in France and collaborates with industry partners and the French government.
core_offerings: French Wine Ingredient Sourcing and Processing

description: L'Essinganaise is a French company specialized in the manufacturing and online sale of prepared and cooked African dishes, including traditional African cuisine, soups, and beverages. The company operates as both a food manufacturer and a service provider in the food industry, focusing on authentic African cuisine. L'Essinganaise serves customers across France and emphasizes traditional African recipes prepared with exotic and ethnic spices sourced directly from Africa, using organic ingredients and aseptic processing.
Paniers d'Eve is a French food manufacturer operating in crop growing, fruit and vegetable processing, and truck farming.

Société Coopérative d’Intérêt Collectif (SCIC), DBA LA MULTILOCALE, is a French cooperative society specialized in regenerative agriculture, food processing, and the promotion of a circular economy. The organization focuses on hyperlocal and local food production, supports local entrepreneurship, and collaborates with enterprises, local authorities, associations, consumers, and training organizations to develop multi-actor territorial projects. LA MULTILOCALE also operates as a business-to-business service provider, supplying food products and offering a platform for entrepreneurs and community members to participate in its initiatives.

PÉPITES SAS, known as Yumi, is a French company engaged in the production and distribution of natural, organic ginger shots and maxishots, as well as other beverage products. The company operates both as a beverage distributor and a soft drinks shop, offering its products through e-commerce and retail channels. Yumi emphasizes sustainability by sourcing ginger from Peru, where it is cultivated organically, and uses cold pressing and high-pressure processing techniques in its production processes.

Domaine Godeau is a French beverage manufacturer and wine producer operating in the food production sector. The company is based in Beaulieu-sur-Layon, Pays de la Loire, France, and specializes in the manufacturing of beverages and food products.
Famille Pouille is a French company specialized in the manufacturing and production of food and beverage products. The company operates primarily in the food and beverage sector.
MILHADE Vins & Spiritueux is a French beverage manufacturer operating in the food production sector. The company serves vignerons, distributors, and clients in the Nouvelle-Aquitaine region.

La Limonaderie de Paris is a French beverage manufacturer specializing in the artisanal and local production of sparkling beverages, including standard and organic options. The company focuses on beverage manufacturing and offers both standard and organic products, serving cafes, hotels, restaurants, journalists, bloggers, influencers, and resellers in the Île-de-France region and beyond. La Limonaderie de Paris also operates as a reseller catalog provider for its products.

AUDEBERT BOISSONS Société par actions simplifiée, DBA Auvergnat Cola, is a French beverage manufacturer and distributor specialized in the production and distribution of regional beverages, with a primary focus on the Auvergne region. The company offers a range of soft drinks, including cola, lemonade, and tonic, made with locally sourced ingredients and traditional production methods. Auvergnat Cola also operates in bottling and packaging, with an emphasis on sustainability and eco-friendly practices.

SAS Fermenting & Co, DBA Fermenting & Co, is a French company engaged in the artisanal production and direct-to-consumer sales of fermented beverages, with a primary focus on kombucha and related plant-based infusions. The company utilizes organic ingredients sourced locally and incorporates sustainable sourcing and waste management practices. Fermenting & Co operates as a food and beverage manufacturer and maintains a focus on environmental responsibility and the use of traditional brewing methods.

INOU is a French company engaged in the production and sale of fruits, with a focus on pressing and processing these fruits into various products. The company operates in Paris and serves the French market.

Conserverie Fourmi is a French company operating as a micro-conserverie and food production business, specializing in the low-tech canning and preservation of seasonal fruits, vegetables, legumes, and mushrooms using renewable energy pasteurization. The company serves local producers, particularly organic and short-circuit producers, as well as private individuals and public entities such as associations and collectivities. In addition to its core production activities, Conserverie Fourmi provides initiation workshops in home canning, including theoretical and practical training and food safety education. The company emphasizes sustainable and circular practices, with a focus on local and organic food production and preservation.
core_offerings: Home Canning Theory and Practice Training

description: Geyer is a French beverage manufacturer specializing in food production, with a focus on the beverage sector. The company produces a variety of drinks, including artisanal lemonade, energy drinks, beers, and a malt-based beverage, and distributes its products through large retailers, convenience stores, and impulse channels. Geyer emphasizes its Made in France heritage.

Kermené is a French company specialized in the production and distribution of butcher and charcuterie products for the food and beverage sector. The company operates industrial production and logistics sites, supplying fresh meat and charcuterie products to E.Leclerc stores across the Côtes-d'Armor region and Brittany. Kermené also manages logistics platforms and is involved in food manufacturing, with a focus on sustainability and environmental protection.
core_offerings: Environmental Protection Services for Food Production
Risk Prevention Services for Food Production

description: GreenLeaf Mate is a French company specialized in the production and distribution of natural, energy-boosting beverages based on maté. The company offers its products in various formats, including single servings, cocktails, and post-workout options, targeting consumers seeking healthier alternatives to traditional energy drinks. GreenLeaf Mate operates as both a beverage manufacturer and distributor, with all production and bottling activities conducted in France. The company emphasizes sustainability by using recyclable glass bottles and eco-friendly packaging.

Elixia is a French manufacturer and distributor specialized in the production of organic limonades made from agave syrup, targeting health-conscious consumers. The company emphasizes sustainability and organic agricultural practices, sourcing ingredients from the Jurassian massif and offering products with low glycemic index and low calorie content. Elixia's offerings are available through its official website and direct contact channels.

Club-Mate is a French food and beverage manufacturer specializing in the production of natural, yerba mate-infused sparkling beverages. The company operates in both Germany and France, offering products such as Club-Mate and other flavors, and is involved in the promotion of bottle return systems for waste reduction. Club-Mate is certified vegan, gluten-free, and lactose-free, and incorporates eco-friendly practices in its operations.

Riviera Kombucha is a French company engaged in the production and distribution of kombucha beverages, with a focus on artisanal and locally sourced ingredients. The company operates as a food manufacturer and tea producer, offering its products to both professional and individual consumers in the French Riviera region. Riviera Kombucha emphasizes natural fermentation methods and the use of locally available plants, vegetables, and fruits in its brewing processes.

Dechelette Estate is a French beverage manufacturer and food producer operating in the food production sector. The company specializes in winemaking, aging, bottling, and distribution management, serving the wine and food industry. It operates in the most prestigious terroirs of France.
